news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.source: GlobeNewswire / Motley Fool (Q2 2026 earnings release & call)
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 116% YoY (and ~20% QoQ) to about $1.93M, IB-Stim unit deliveries grew 60% YoY, gross margin expanded ~230bps, and cash stood at $8.3M, but revenue landed just under the roughly $2.0M consensus estimate and shares fell on the print despite the record growth. CEO Brian Carrico reiterated an aim to expand PENFS covered lives well past 200M by 2027, while flagging that cash burn should rise in H2 2026 as the company invests in sales, marketing, and clinical research.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim adding over 500,000 covered lives, concentrated in the Mid-Atlantic region, extending the reimbursement build-out that followed the new Category I CPT code.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a same-day 9:00am ET conference call and webcast.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board authorized a Q2 dividend on Series B Preferred Stock payable in roughly 80,463 shares of common stock (calculated at $2.38/share) rather than cash, conserving cash at the cost of modest additional dilution to common holders.

catalysts.label: Larger payer/customer wins and continued reimbursement expansion
catalysts.detail: Management is guiding to bigger commercial and payer wins in H2 2026 into 2027, building on the Category I CPT code; CEO has said he'd be "highly disappointed" if PENFS covered lives were not above 200M by 2027.

catalysts.label: VA Federal Supply Schedule ramp
catalysts.detail: IB-Stim's VA FSS listing (effective Dec 2025) opens access to ~7M VA patients annually; management expects this channel to contribute more meaningfully through 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: Based on prior-quarter cadence (Mar/May/Aug reporting dates), the next quarterly report is expected mid-to-late November 2026; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Clinical trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Multiple ongoing studies could generate data over time, including an investigator-initiated adult functional dyspepsia RCT, a pediatric Cyclic Vomiting Syndrome RCT, an NIH-funded adult study with Emory/Atlanta VA, and a randomized double-blind study at Cleveland Clinic and Stanford.

catalysts.label: Going-concern / capital needs
catalysts.detail: The company continues to carry a going-concern qualification and relies on its at-the-market facility and other financing to fund operations until it reaches cash-flow breakeven, which remains a watch item for H2 2026.

pulse: NeurAxis posted its strongest quarter yet on Aug 11 (revenue +116% YoY to ~$1.9M, unit deliveries +60% YoY, cash of $8.3M) but shares sold off because the print landed just shy of consensus, even as management doubled down on ambitious payer-coverage and VA channel targets for H2 2026 into 2027. A further payer-coverage expansion (Aug 4, +500K covered lives) and a routine Series B preferred stock dividend (Jul 9) round out the last six weeks of news, with no major catalyst since the earnings call. The going-concern qualification and reliance on the ATM facility remain the key overhangs as the company pushes toward cash-flow breakeven.
